name: What are the common signs a commercial water heater needs replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs a commercial water heater needs replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs a commercial water heater needs replacement include inconsistent hot water supply, visible leaks around the unit, rust-colored water, strange noises like rumbling or popping, and a noticeable increase in energy bills. For businesses in Las Vegas, increased maintenance needs or frequent repairs can also signal it's time to consider a new unit, especially given the continuous demand. Assessing these signs early can prevent unexpected outages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inconsistent hot water, leaks, rust-colored water, strange noises, and rising energy bills are common signs. Increased maintenance in demanding environments like Las Vegas can also indicate replacement is needed.
